costs.title: Costs
costs.description: Inference spend, platform fees, credits, and live quota windows.
costs.emptyOrganization: Select an organization to view costs.
costs.customPrompt: Select a start and end date to load data.

overview.inferenceLedgerDescription: Request-scoped inference spend for the selected period.
overview.budgetUtilization: {{percent}}% of monthly budget consumed in this range.

byAgent.title: By agent
byAgent.description: What each agent consumed in the selected period.

byProject.title: By project
byProject.description: Run costs attributed through project-linked tasks.

finance.ledgerDescription: Account-level charges that do not map to a single inference request.
finance.netSubtitle: Debit minus credit for the selected period
finance.estimatedSubtitle: Estimated debits that are not yet invoice-authoritative
finance.byBillerDescription: Account-level financial events grouped by who charged or credited them.
finance.timelineEmpty: No finance events yet. Add account-level charges once biller invoices or credits land.

budgets.controlPlaneDescription: Hard-stop spend limits for agents and projects. Provider subscription quota stays separate and appears under Providers.
budgets.activeIncidentsSubtitle: Open soft or hard threshold crossings
budgets.pendingApprovalsSubtitle: Budget override approvals awaiting board action
budgets.activeIncidentsDescription: Resolve hard stops here by raising the budget or explicitly keeping the scope paused.
budgets.agentBudgetsDescription: Recurring monthly spend policies for individual agents.
budgets.projectBudgetsDescription: Lifetime spend policies for execution-bound projects.
budgets.noPolicies: No budget policies yet. Set agent and project budgets from their detail pages, or use the existing organization monthly budget control.

incident.warningNotice: Spending crossed the warning threshold. This warning does not pause work.
incident.budgetMustExceed: The new budget must exceed current observed spend.
incident.spendingReached: Spending reached {{observed}} against a limit of {{limit}}.
incident.projectPausedNotice: Project execution is paused. New work in this project will not start until you resolve the budget incident.
incident.scopePausedNotice: This scope is paused. New heartbeats will not start until you resolve the budget incident.
incident.raiseHint: Raise above current spend to resume immediately, or keep the scope paused while you investigate.

policy.projectPausedNotice: Execution is paused for this project until the budget block is resolved.
policy.scopePausedNotice: Heartbeats are paused for this scope until the budget block is resolved.

providers.empty: No cost events in this period.

billers.empty: No billable events in this period.

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution tasks.
routines.emptyOrganization: Select an organization to view routines.

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.coalesceIfActive: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrency.alwaysEnqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrency.skipIfActive: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.

catchUp.label: Catch-up
catchUp.skipMissed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUp.enqueueMissedWithCap: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.

composer.title: New routine
composer.subtitle: Define the recurring work first. Default project and agent are optional for draft routines.
composer.advancedSubtitle: Keep policy controls secondary to the work definition.
composer.footerNotice: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.

routines.emptyActive: No active routines. Use Create routine to define the first recurring workflow.

toasts.createdWithAgent: Add the first trigger to turn it into a live workflow.
toasts.createdDraft: Draft saved. Add a default agent before enabling automation.
toasts.defaultAgentRequiredBody: Set a default agent before enabling routine automation.
